name: Iron Bands of Bilarro

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Throw the bands
powers.text: Magic action (once per dawn): throw the sphere at a creature within 60 ft (a ranged attack with your Dex + Proficiency): it's Restrained until it breaks free (DC 20 Strength).

summary: Thrown at a creature, it springs open into iron bands that hold it Restrained (DC 20 Strength to break).
text: A rusty iron ball 3 inches across that weighs 1 pound. As a Magic action, hurl it at a creature no larger than Huge, up to 60 feet away, that you can see; in flight it unfolds into a mass of metal bands. Your ranged attack roll adds your Proficiency Bonus and your Dexterity modifier. A hit leaves the target Restrained until you say the command word again as a Bonus Action to let it go. Releasing the target, or missing, makes the bands fold back into a ball. Any creature, the captive included, can spend an action on a Strength (Athletics) check against DC 20 to snap the bands; success destroys the item and frees the creature, while failure means that creature's later attempts fail automatically for 24 hours. The bands work once, then not again until the next dawn.
